newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet first half sales fell.
newsitem.headline: Eramet first half sales fell.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French unless stated)
NOTE - Eramet gave its figures in a statement. It said the the consolidated figures were comparable and excluded manganese company Comilog.

Nickel production at the Doniambo plant in New Caledonia was up 6.1 percent from a year ago, reaching 27,836 tonnes. But deliveries were only up 0.5 percent due to strikes at the port of Noumea at the end of June, which caused delays in deliveries and pushed invoicing into July.
The average dollar price of nickel was significantly lower than a year ago due to increased availability of recycled nickel from eastern Europe.
However, in franc terms, average prices were 0.5 percent higher due to the sharp gain in the dollar against the French currency.
In rapid steel, the gradual improvement seen at the start of the year was confirmed in the first half but tool making companies have not shown the exceptional demand seen in the first half of 1996.
